key_findings: Calculus bovis protects the in vitro neurovascular unit/BBB after OGD/R by restoring tight junction proteins and reducing inflammation, oxidative stress and apoptosis.
Protection is linked to the HIF-1α/VEGF and PI3K/Akt pathways.
